sub_sections.title: Easter Eggs
sub_sections.description_text:
[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XbTgq3eotxo]Why am I here?[/url][/h1]

[previewimg=34510171;sizeFull,inline;Screenshot (321).png][/previewimg]
On the multiplayer map Beaver Creek in Halo 2 you can find a secret message by the sniper spawn asking the question "Why am I here?" This is a reference to the time old question of "Do you ever wounder why we're here?" from the very first episode of Red vs. Blue. Finding this will also grant you the "Why Am I Here?" achievement.
[previewicon=34509996;sizeThumb,inline;Screenshot (318) - Copy.png][/previewicon]






[h1]I think it looks more like a Puma[/h1]

Following the famous line from the first season and fans referring to the warthog as a puma, the developers took notice and decided to add the text "Puma" to the tires of the warthog in Halo 3 through into Halo: Reach.
[previewimg=34510412;sizeFull,inline;Screenshot (314).png][/previewimg]
[previewimg=34510416;sizeFull,inline;Screenshot (313)2.png][/previewimg]






[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rmOzAE-CbLY]GrifBall[/url][/h1]
[previewimg=34999966;sizeFull,inline;Screenshot (438).png][/previewimg]
Grifball is a community-created gametype made by Burnie Burns of Rooster Teeth.
The origin of Grifball can be traced back to an interview with its creator:

"In Season Four of Red vs Blue, Sarge is taking pot-shots with a Sniper Rifle at Grif, whom he hates. He’s having a great time and blurts out 'This is the best game since Grifball!' That was written about three years ago and we always wondered what kind of game Grifball would have been. That’s why the ball carrier turns orange – everyone in the game is constantly trying to hammer-smash Grif and even if he scores, he explodes. Either way, Sarge wins."

While the first off-hand joke about "Grifball" was made in Season 4 of Red vs. Blue, the actual practical development of the gametype only started three years later when Rooster Teeth was making the Heroic Map Pack "D.I.Y." trailer and experimenting with Forge and custom Assault game types in the Foundry map.






[h1]Rooster Teeth Vending Machines[/h1]
On the Halo 2 Classic Map Turf you can find two vending machines on either side of the map, one with a rooster and one with Teeth. Although this isn't a direct reference to Red vs Blue, The company name Rooster Teeth was founded on a recurring insult throughout the series where members of the cast would call each other "c**k bite". This inadvertently makes it a Red vs Blue reference.
[previewimg=34520356;sizeFull,inline;Screenshot (320).png][/previewimg]
[previewimg=34520364;sizeFull,inline;Screenshot (319)2.png][/previewimg]




-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HUTUiv6uU2U]Halseys Lab[/url][/h1]
[previewimg=35000007;sizeFull,inline;Screenshot (465).png][/previewimg]
Once you complete the easter egg and reach Halseys Lab you will find on one of the computer databases a tribute to Red vs. Blue with the text below reading:

SUBJECT: RvB [CIV] KNOWN ASSOC.: Burns B, Hullum M, Ramsey G,
Gustavo S, Saldana J, et al.

This one and his cohorts have piqued my curiosity with their incessant
puppeteering. While we busy ourselves bending all of this technology in
service of the war, they twist and contort the public message of our
effort into something else.

I'll admit, like the massive menagerie of men and women that now hang
on their every word, I've laughed at their antics on more than one
occasion. I find their incessant mockery and immaturity strangely
cathartic, even if I cannot help but question whether or not this
protracted war has wreaked irreversible harm and havoc upon these
poor souls' sanity.






[h1]Dialogue references Halo 3[/h1]
I couldn't find any actual recordings of these but they are doccumented as official in game lines on the [url=https://halo.fandom.com/wiki/UNSC_Marine_Corps/Quotes]Halo Alpha site.[/url]

Entering passenger
"Shotgun!"
"Shotgun! S**t!" IWHBYD needed, reference to RvB.

"Got something for ya!" - Throwing a Grenade. Possibly a reference to Red vs Blue when Donut kills Tex.

"Damn, I should have brought my mittens." - Red vs Blue reference to Caboose.




[h1]Rooster Teeth Marines[/h1]
In several missions, there are UNSC Army soldiers who will fight alongside you in the game with aliases from the voice actors of Red vs Blue:

Gustavo Sorola, voice of Simmons, appears in Exodus, Pillar of Autumn, and on The Package.
Geoff Ramsey, voice of Grif, appears in ONI: Sword Base, Exodus and Nightfall.
Burnie Burns, voice of Church and Vic; appears in Nightfall.
Matt Hullum, voice of Sarge, Doc, and O'Malley, appears on The Package.




[h1]Reach Dialogue[/h1]
There is also a reference when an Elite dies saying "HURK! BLAH!," which is a common saying made by characters that are dying in Red vs Blue. Elites will also yell out either "HONK!" or "BLARG," which are common sayings from the Elite in the series.

sub_sections.title: Spartan Ops Radio Easter Eggs
sub_sections.description_text:
Episode - Chapter

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dFUSFa3Y6cs]1-5 Core[/url]
Commander Palmer: "Commander Palmer to Fireteam Castle. You're on Spartans, Dalton's got targets for you."
Caboose: "Um, the regular radio guy isn't here right now. Sorry."

While Crimson is defending the artifact.

Commander Palmer: "Fireteam Castle, this is Commander Palmer. I need an ETA on clear skies."
Caboose: "Seriously, the regular radio guy said he'd be right back. He's in the bathroom."

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cVmeGQtKIak]2-5 Gagarin[/url]
Crimson activates the first computer.

Caboose: "What does this button do?"
Church: "Caboose, don't touch anything!"
Caboose: "But I'm great at buttons. Oh, look at that explosion!"
Recording ends.

Crimson activates the second.

Church: "Oh great! You broke it!"
Caboose: "No. The fire broke it - ah, see? Great, now I'm on fire too now. Awesome."

Recording ends. Crimson activates the third.

Grif: "Hey, Simmons? What do you think this thing does?"
Simmons: "How would I know? It's a forty-foot, seamless monolith with one massive holographic button. It could be anything from a giant microwave oven to a weapon with enough power to-"
Caboose: [screaming] "I'm on fire!"
Simmons: "Hey, is that Caboose?"
Caboose: [indistinct screaming]
Grif: "Probably. He's on fire."
Caboose: [screaming] "It's like the armor! It does nothing! Ah!"

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Do-2RJbz048]3-4 Shootout In Valhalla[/url]
Pelicans fly in with Mantises.

Simmons: "Hold tight, ground forces. We are inbound with reinforcements. Don't wanna say exactly what, but you'll like 'em!"
Grif: "It's giant robots."
Simmons: "What?! Grif! You ruined the surprise! You have no flair for the dramatic."
Grif: "They're in battle, idiot! How dramatic do you want it to get?"

Pelicans drop Mantises.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dFHtgk0ctHc]4-2 Rally Point[/url]
When Crimson reaches the waterfront tower.

Vic: "Hello? Hello? Commander Palmer, hello? Do you read me?"
Pause.

Commander Palmer: "What are you even doing?"
Pause

Vic: "Oh, come on, dude! I thought you saved my number at the party last night. You were really killin' it at the karaoke. If you know what I'm sayin', dude."
Pause.

Commander Palmer: "Miller? Status?"
Miller: "Working on it, Commander."
Pause.

Vic: "Yeesh! Easy there, Commander Buzzkill. I'm going to 80's night tomorrow, so hey. Give me a buzz after you save the universe and all that. Hasta luego. Luego bye bye."

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jU7C0g9IUDE]5-5 Spartan Thorne[/url]
When the equipment drop comes.

Sarge: "I heard you boys wanted a lift, but all I've got are these guns. I suppose you could assemble some sort of primitive gun-like vehicle out of the parts... But who knows what the insurance rate would be on that bad boy"

Several Gravity Hammers marked "Sports equipment" are dropped.

Sarge: "Dammit, Grif! You dropped your cargo! Now how are we supposed to play Grifball?"
Grif: "I think the bigger question here might be why a military vehicle was sent into battle with sports equipment?"

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uoB9vcAWB88]6-4 Search and Destroy[/url]
After Crimson has reached the nukes.

Sarge: (mocking voice) "This is Corporal Switchback to Infinity!"
Commander Palmer: "Go ahead, Switchback."
Sarge: "Hey Infinity, is your slipspace drive running? Because you'd better go catch it!"
Commander Palmer: "Crimson, you're the closest responder. Fall out and help Switchback."
Grif: "Babba booey! Babba booey!"

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q8Kd71UufmM]7-3 Engine of Destruction[/url]
When Crimson disables the warhead in the server room.

Simmons: "Private Simmons to Command! There was a huge firefight down here, and engine's all shot up! I need Maintenance ASAP!"
Miller: "Keep it together, marine. Spartans are on the way."
Simmons: (sarcastically) "Oh, great! More people with guns! I'm sure THAT'LL fix the engine!"

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5DnQp_2s7yo]8-2 Majestic Rescue[/url]
When the equipment drop comes.

Miller: "I'm having Dalton drop some extra gear for you now."
Caboose: "Six crates of elbow grease and headlight fluid inbound now."

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5gt6YyWsId0]9-5 The Hammer[/url]
After Crimson activates a Hawk squad IFF tag.

Roland: "Alright, I've got a recording from a Hawk IFF tag, playing it now."
Elite: (speaking Sangheilian)
Church: "Yeah, I have absolutely no idea what you just said."
Elite: (speaking Sangheilian)
Church: "Dude, listen to me! I do not speak alien!"

Plasma fire.

Church: "Oh, this is such BS!"

Energy sword.

Church: "Blarg!"

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gjEuNpLTpUo]10-3 Seize The Power[/url]
When Crimson is about to board the Lich.

Miller: "Crimson, I can't say I think it's sane but it's the only move we've got. Get on board the Lich by any means necessary."
Agent Georgia: "Cool, jetpacks. That'll help us get on that ship or my name isn't Agent Georgia."

sub_sections.title: Easter Eggs Part 2
sub_sections.description_text:
[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dvGqjr5nxHc]What's the password?[/url][/h1]
In the Halo 3 mission "CROW'S NEST" Rally point alpha, shortly after you encounter your first wave of enemies you continue straight down that big hallway till you find a  curve in the hallway that leads down a slope. on your right you will find a Marine knocking on a fortified door asking to be let in with a voice coming from the other side. These are the voice actors from the Red vs. Blue cast and will change depending on the difficulty.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3](Easy/Normal Transcript)[/h3]
[h3]Marine: (Jason Saldana, Tucker) Voice: (Matt Hullum, Doc)[/h3]

Tucker: Hey, open up!

Doc's Voice: Password, please.

Tucker: You gotta be kidding me! What password?

Doc's Voice: The password so we don't open the door for Brutes.

Tucker: Do I sound like a Brute to you?!

Doc's Voice: Well, you could be held prisoner by Brutes.

Tucker: If I was held prisoner by Brutes and knew the password, then the Brutes could just force me to tell you the password and you'd open the door for them.

[Brief pause]

Doc's Voice: Okay, well now I'm definitely not gonna open the door.

Tucker: But we need ammo!

Doc's Voice: Well why don't you go ask your Brute buddies, then?

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3](Heroic Transcript)[/h3]
[h3]Marine: (Gustavo Sorola, Simmons) Voice: (Geoff Ramsey, Grif)[/h3]

Simmons: Hey, open up!

Grif's Voice: Password.

Simmons: What?

Grif's Voice: Need the password!

Simmons: You gotta be kidding me! What password?

Grif's Voice: Password! They gave it out at the staff meeting fifteen minutes ago!

Simmons: Meeting? What meeting?! I was out here!

Grif's Voice: Not supposed to let anyone in without it.

Simmons: If the staff meeting just ended, no one outside is gonna know the freakin' password! Now open up! We need ammo and the Chief is out here!

[Brief pause]

Grif's Voice: Does he know the password?

Simmons: He wasn't at the meeting either!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3](Legendary Transcript)[/h3]
[h3]Marine: (Burnie Burns, Church) Voice: (Joel Heyman, Caboose)[/h3]

Church: Hey! Open up!

Caboose's Voice: What's the password?

Church: Password? Oh man, I forgot.

Caboose's Voice: Forgot... what?

Church: I forgot the password.

Caboose's Voice: See, that was almost right. Uh, see, the password begins with "I forgot," but ends differently. Um, try again.

Church: No. I mean, I forgot the password.

Caboose's Voice: No, okay, see, you - you got it wrong again. See, you said the same thing as last time.

[Brief pause]

Church: *sigh* I'm being serious; I don't know the password!

Caboose's Voice: No no, see, you changed the first part. See, that - that part was the right part. See, now you've got the whole thing wrong!

Church: No! I forgot what the password is and I just need you to open the door!

[Brief Pause]

Caboose's Voice: Alright, c'mon, man, now you're just guessing!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
